explanation: Slide a window while counting still-missing keyword occurrences. Expand until every keyword is covered, then shrink from the left, retaining a strictly shorter complete window and preserving the earliest tie.
timeComplexity: O(S+n+k) expected time for n words, k keywords and S hashed characters.
spaceComplexity: O(k) count entries plus stored keyword characters.
